summary: Frontend-only comprehensive Playwright testing of the editorial bridal makeup artist SPA. Verified layout/colours, header/footer logos, 3D hero scene, mobile responsiveness, navigation, Face Studio (sample, upload, camera, look presets, shade swatches, intensity slider, toggles, download, reset), 3D lipstick viewer, portfolio filters/lightbox, FAQ accordion, contact form. Overall the app is in very good shape - all critical user flows are functional with correct pink brand palette (rgb(230,46,107)) and cream/blush section backgrounds. Only minor issues found.

ui_bugs.issue: Download anchor is created but never appended to the DOM before a.click(). Chromium usually still fires the download, but Playwright's expect_download did not detect a download event in headless testing. Suggest appending 'a' to document.body, clicking, then removing it, and revoking the object URL after use.
Reset only restores idle state; the shade/look/intensity/toggle selections persist across resets. Not blocking but user may expect selections to reset as well.

issues: Event date input uses the browser's native <input type='date'> picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar component required by design guidelines

action_items: Replace <input type='date'> in Contact.jsx with the shadcn Calendar/DatePicker component for consistency with the rest of the design system
Fix FaceStudio download() to append the anchor to document.body before click (and revoke URL after) so downloads are reliably captured by browsers/Playwright
critical_code_review_comments: FaceStudio.jsx download(): temporary <a> element not appended to DOM and object URL never revoked (memory leak on repeated downloads)
Contact.jsx uses native date input rather than shadcn Calendar - inconsistent with design system
Console warnings from Three.js (THREE.Clock deprecated) and framer-motion scroll offset warning - not blocking but should be addressed for cleaner logs
seed_data_creation: None. Contact form submission stored in localStorage.rk_enquiries as designed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Face Studio flows work: sample model, upload (/app/frontend/public/sample-face.jpg), look presets change canvas pixels, shade swatch selection ring visible, intensity slider updates, eyeliner/gloss toggles toggle on/off text, lipstick 3D viewer renders a canvas. Portfolio lightbox opens/closes correctly (DOM presence check needed - is_visible can return true during fade-out). MediaPipe FaceLandmarker initialises in ~2-6s in headless. Camera button: in Playwright headless the fake media is granted so no 'Camera access blocked' message appears - to properly test the denial path, launch Chromium with --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream=false or override permissions to deny 'camera'. Colours: marquee/buttons rgb(230,46,107); pricing/testimonials/footer rgb(251,233,240). Mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow. Both header and footer logo links point to https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/ without target=_blank as required.
rca of the issue: N/A - no critical issues found; only minor download-anchor DOM attachment and design-system consistency (native date picker) points noted.
